# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a stable tech job to pursue entrepreneurship and self-directed projects.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered orchestrator for autonomous software development using Claude with Linear integration and Git workflows.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice guide to color theory covering wheels, dimensions, harmony schemes, and perceptual color spaces.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canal theories to modern spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Detailed explanation of sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Mechanism](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked celestial movements.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through sensory and sensorimotor phases, with neural circuits and critical periods analogous to human speech.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Explores why flat maps distort Earth, comparing projection types and their real-world uses.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores the chemistry of cold light, counterillumination camouflage, deep-sea organisms, and green fluorescent protein's biological impact.
- [Pokémon's Origins and Development](https://www.justinhe.com/x): How a Tokyo boy's insect collecting inspired the world's highest-grossing media franchise through six years of development.
- [Pokémon Competitive Metagame](https://www.justinhe.com/y): How players built competitive Pokémon's ruleset through datamining hidden mechanics and community standards.
- [Pokémon Red and Blue Glitches](https://www.justinhe.com/z): Exploration of famous generation one bugs including MissingNo., the truck myth, and the Mew glitch.
